question: Dr. Bhupendra Kumar Hazarika won the Bharat Ratna award in the field of __________ in 2019.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Music**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Bhupendra Kumar Hazarika** was a renowned Indian playback singer, lyricist, musician, singer, poet, and film-maker.
 
• He was awarded the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award, posthumously in **2019**. - His contributions were primarily in the field of music, where he composed numerous songs in Assamese, Hindi, and Bengali.
 
• Bhupen Hazarika was also known for his role in popularizing **Assamese folk music and culture**.
 
• He was a recipient of several other prestigious awards, including the **Padma Bhushan and the Padma Vibhushan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Award
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Bharat Ratna
 India's highest civilian award, given for exceptional service towards the advancement of art, literature, and science, and in recognition of public service of the highest order.
 
 

 Padma Bhushan
 India's third-highest civilian award, given for distinguished service of a high order in any field.
 
 

 Padma Vibhushan
 India's second-highest civilian award, given for exceptional and distinguished service in any field, including service rendered by Government servants.
 
 

 National Film Award
 India's most prominent film award ceremony, recognizing excellence in the Indian film industry.
 
 

 Sangeet Natak Akademi Award
 India's national academy for music, dance, and drama, recognizing outstanding achievement in these fields.
